# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Fighter level 10 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted GE-06 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Fighter pilot to
# level 10 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam and
# the deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield posture. Level 10 grants
# another bonus feat (the cadence is 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10), so this fixture adds the
# choice:fighter_bonus_feat_10 selection (canonically feat:greater_weapon_focus,
# whose prerequisites — Weapon Focus (longsword) and fighter level 8 — the
# canonical loadout honestly meets); it introduces no new armor-training or
# weapon-training milestone (Armor Training 2 stayed at level 7 and Weapon
# Training 2 stayed at level 9).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-fighter-level10
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:fighter:10
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
feat=feat:dodge
feat=feat:weapon_focus
feat=feat:toughness
feat=feat:cleave
feat=feat:combat_reflexes
feat=feat:improved_critical
feat=feat:greater_weapon_focus
skill=skill:climb:1
skill=skill:intimidate:1
skill=skill:swim:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
equipment=power_attack:selected_inactive
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat:feat:weapon_focus:weapon:longsword
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat_2:feat:toughness
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat_4:feat:cleave
choice=choice:fighter_weapon_training_group:group:heavy_blades
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat_6:feat:combat_reflexes
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat_8:feat:improved_critical
choice=choice:fighter_weapon_training_group_2:group:bows

choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
